content_data.project_title: ElevateEDU: Reimagining the European Education Platform UX
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive redesign initiative to enhance the user experience and visual identity of our pan-European education platform, focusing on intuitive navigation, engagement, and accessibility for diverse user groups.
content_data.timeline: 6 months, with an initial discovery phase (first 6 weeks) and iterative design sprints thereafter.
objectives: Increase user engagement metrics by 20% across all platform modules within the first year post-launch.
Establish a consistent and cohesive visual language that resonates with a diverse European audience.
Improve discoverability of educational content and resources by streamlining information architecture.
deliverables: Design system documentation including component library and usage guidelines.
High-fidelity UI mockups for core platform modules and components.
Comprehensive UX audit report with actionable recommendations.
creative_requirements: Development of new iconography and illustration style.
Integration of motion design principles for enhanced user feedback and engagement.
content_data.design_style: Modern, clean, and inclusive with a focus on pedagogical clarity and cultural sensitivity. Emphasizing intuitive visual hierarchy and engaging micro-interactions.
